aliases: Fire date tree thousand year fire date tree Fire date forest

summary.text: Fire date trees resist extreme heat and lava, and old specimens can serve as living foundation for a spring dream fruit tree.

claims.text: At a Central Continent volcano site, old man Chen plans to cut a fire date tree for his son’s house girder. Fire date trees are extremely resistant to heat and can even resist lava, which is why they keep existing through centuries of eruptions that destroy villages around the fertile ash farmland. That specimen is several thousand years old and has stopped producing dates.

A spring dream fruit tree exists in dreams without a material body and needs a real living tree as foundation. This fire date tree supports that spring dream fruit tree; cutting or moving the date tree without matching dream path methods destroys the spring dream fruit tree and leaves only an ordinary date tree.
Fang Yuan later recalls the same pairing as a thousand year fire date tree at the volcano base, still unable to transplant it safely.

Fire Plain grotto-heaven holds a huge fire date forest among its remaining valuable resources after Fang Yuan’s subordinates take the grotto-heaven. Most immortal materials there are fire path, and date flame is the largest quantity among the many flame stocks he also gains.
